raw_record.question_text: Find the measure of $\angle 4$ if $m\angle 4 = m\angle 5$.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：The diagram shows a left triangle with a 63° top angle, a central intersection on a horizontal line, a 69° angle above the center on the left side, a 47° angle above the center on the right side, and a lower triangle below the line with ∠3 at the center, ∠4 at the bottom, and ∠5 at the left. 先推理：From the straight line across the center, ∠1 + 69° + 47° = 180°, so ∠1 = 64°. The slanted line through the top-left apex and the bottom vertex is straight, so ∠1 and ∠3 form a linear pair: ∠3 = 180° - 64° = 116°. In the lower triangle, ∠3 + ∠4 + ∠5 = 180°, and the text gives m∠4 = m∠5, so 116° + 2∠4 = 180°. Therefore ∠4 = 32°.
